title: Measure Department Standards: Entry & Patio Door Contract Appointments, Missed Visits and Remeasures
content:
Door measure appointments on Entry & Patio Door Contracts are performed by a Ridgeline measure technician, who records the rough opening, handing and swing of each unit.

## Standard 1: when a visit can be booked

A door measure visit can be booked only while the contract status is signed or measured. The status is read from the contract record.

| Contract status | Measure visit can be booked |
|---|---|
| Signed | Yes |
| Measured | Yes |
| Ordered, installed, closed or cancelled | No |

## Standard 2: the final measure

A completed final measure confirms the units and their sizes and moves the contract to measured with the measured unit count and the visit date.

## Standard 3: missed appointments

- A **customer no-show** (nobody gives access within 30 minutes of the appointment start) is a missed appointment.
- A **late reschedule** (a customer reschedule given with less than the series reschedule notice before the appointment start) is a missed appointment.
- A **company-rescheduled** appointment never is.

The missed appointments of a contract are counted over the contract's lifetime up to and including the appointment being handled; those up to the waived count carry no fee and each later one carries the series missed-appointment fee on the date of the missed appointment.

## Standard 4: remeasures

A remeasure the customer asks for after the final measure is free up to the series free remeasure count and carries the series remeasure fee after that. The customer remeasures counted are the completed customer-requested remeasure visits of the contract, up to and including the visit being handled. A company remeasure (one ordered by Ridgeline) is always free and is not counted. A remeasure never changes the contract status.

## Applying the standards (hypothetical appointments)

| Situation | Missed appointment | Fee |
|---|---|---|
| Customer reschedules 30 hours before the start, series notice 24 hours | No | None |
| Customer reschedules exactly 24 hours before the start, series notice 24 hours | No | None |
| Customer reschedules 20 hours before the start, series notice 24 hours | Yes | Missed-appointment fee if it is beyond the waived count |
| Nobody gives access within 30 minutes of the start | Yes | Missed-appointment fee if it is beyond the waived count |
| Ridgeline moves the appointment | No | None |

- On a series that waives 1 missed appointment with a $75.00 fee, the first missed appointment carries no fee and the second carries $75.00, assessed on the date of that second missed appointment.
- On a series with 2 free remeasures and a $175.00 remeasure fee, the customer's first and second completed remeasures are free and the third carries $175.00. A company remeasure in between is free and does not move that count.
